mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park and a current temperature of 58 degrees, plus a beautiful waning crescent moon overhead.

In city news, the police department has arrested a 34-year-old school staff member following an investigation into an incident from 2019. Also, be aware that Phase two of road construction on Highway M begins the week of September 7, which will cause traffic shifts and lane changes.

There is plenty going on this week, including yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can check out trivia at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company, and on September 9th, there are several events including the Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park.
The Verona Police Department reported that on Sunday, August 30, they received information regarding a sexual assault of a child by a school staff member, which led to an arrest this past Friday.
Today's flavor is Georgia Peach. The restaurant is currently closed but will be ready to serve you when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
